pages.text: This handbook and the in-game codex form a read-only reference layer: Patchouli entries, the demon-beast bestiary, the chronicle, and quick references for terms and values.

pages.text: This module never changes gameplay state. It only reads bestiary unlocks and chronicle discovery records.
